cases.title: Default source exclusion
cases.required_evidence: Real launch output and runtime-native discovery; stubs prove argument wiring only.

cases.title: Example toolbox mapping
cases.required_evidence: Actual toolbox projection and supported app-server versus terminal statuses.

cases.title: Ordering and cross-member definitions
cases.required_evidence: Real canonical bytes, generated artifacts, pinned digest and native catalogs.

cases.title: Validation and resolution
cases.required_evidence: Actual crew-core or launch validation errors; no copied validation logic.

cases.title: Secret delivery and scrubbing
cases.required_evidence: Real proxy and PTY/sandbox/app-server isolation with negative secret controls.

cases.title: Missing references
cases.required_evidence: Actual readiness result for optional, required and strict members.

cases.title: Spawn restart resume stability
cases.required_evidence: Actual lifecycle transitions; same member prerequisites.

cases.title: Reload pending changes
cases.required_evidence: Running daemon reload, unchanged launch artifacts and transition events.

cases.title: File snapshots and limits
cases.required_evidence: Real content store and refusal reason including size.

cases.title: Runtime switch
cases.required_evidence: Real model switch policy; required item refusal.

cases.title: Member addition and subagents
cases.required_evidence: Real tool schemas, saved roster and active parent snapshot inheritance.

cases.title: Operator source selection
cases.required_evidence: Runtime-native listings and sandbox run; enumerate exclusion limitations.

cases.title: Strict exclusion
cases.required_evidence: Actual unsandboxed launch refusal with source reason.

cases.title: Pinned proxy definitions
cases.required_evidence: Real forwarding proxy; unsorted mutable stub is a negative control.

cases.title: Dashboard parity
cases.required_evidence: Each consumer reads real protocol payload; native UI tests or stated platform limits.

cases.title: Per-turn cache attribution
cases.required_evidence: Provider-authorized paired warm sessions with TTL/model/endpoint and per-turn reads/writes.

cases.title: Shell applicability
cases.required_evidence: Actual shell mapping under strict.

cases.title: Resume after tool removal
cases.required_evidence: Real runtime resume history or verified fresh-session handoff.

cases.title: Sandbox and stale files
cases.required_evidence: Actual sandbox mounts and restart cleanup; filesystem fixtures alone do not prove it.

cases.title: Readiness failures
cases.required_evidence: Actual preflight deadline and live session failure reporting.

cases.title: Crew role and cache rule gaps
cases.required_evidence: Real crew role identity and proxy plus gateway/alwaysLoad paths.
